IT SCROLLS NOW

These frames are the whole page, not one viewport. On a phone you see the header, the dial and the first services; everything below arrives on a swipe. The tab bar sits outside the scroll, so it never moves.

THE DIAL, AT THE TOP

It is the first thing on the page, so it is the first thing a thumb finds, and the logo is blurred into the red behind it — a real gaussian blur, not a dimmed copy, because a logo at low opacity keeps its hard edges and reads as a second weaker logo rather than as depth.

Three things move on one 1.5s beat: the dial pops, a beacon swells out from behind it, the dot beside EMERGENCY blinks. The beacon is capped at 1.19x inside a fixed square, so it never touches a tile. All of it stops under reduced motion (NFR-18).

ONE THING TO DECIDE: because the page scrolls, the dial can scroll out of sight. For the one button someone reaches for in a panic that is worth fixing — a small red pill that sticks to the bottom once the dial leaves the screen. Say the word and I will add it.

WHAT THE PAGE HOLDS NOW, IN ORDER

1. The emergency dial, with the OTP warning welded under it
2. My Active Case, when one is open (left board only)
3. All eight services, 2 x 4
4. Upcoming
5. Connect DigiLocker
6. The two closing offers

UPCOMING is the only section ordered by time rather than by importance, which is the point: a renewal date does not care how important the paper is. Every row is a real vault document, soonest first, and the chip turns red once the date has passed.

The health insurance policy has been removed from the vault. Motor insurance moved into the insurance category with it — it genuinely is a policy, and without it Insurance & Claims would have had nothing left to read.

TWO THINGS THAT ARE NOT IN SCOPE V1

CONNECT DIGILOCKER and GET A DRAFT are both new. Per the scope document's own rule they need a change request before either is built for real, so neither pretends to work: DigiLocker opens the vault rather than holding a government session it does not have, and Get a Draft opens a consultation.

Both closing offers end at an advocate on purpose. Drafting a will or a legal notice is advocate work, and the compliance rules are explicit that the assistant gives information rather than advice (FR-AIA-02/03). They are two doors into the same room at the moment — tell me if you want the drafting one to become its own flow.
